'''Mangū Shrine''' (まんぐうじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} located in the Tsukamoto district of {{ill|Kannami|arz|كاننامى|ceb|Kannami-chō|eo|Kannami|es|Kannami|fa|کاننامی|fr|Kannami|id|Kannami, Shizuoka|it|Kannami|ja|函南町|ko|간나미정|ms|Kannami, Shizuoka|my|ခန်းနမိမြို့|pl|Kannami|ru|Каннами|sv|Kannami|tl|Kannami, Shizuoka|tr|Kannami|uk|Каннамі|ur|کنامی|zh|函南町|qid=Q1203533}}, {{ill|Tagata District, Shizuoka|Q1154841|qid=Q1154841}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}.<ref name="yuisho">[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4402077 Mangū Shrine] - Shizuoka Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines</ref>

=== Overview ===
The shrine is situated on the southern foothills of Moriyama, a small hill located in the center of the rural Tsukamoto area.<ref name="isan">[https://kannami13.sakura.ne.jp/geo-8.html Moriyama] - Kannami Heritage</ref>

It is considered a disputed shrine (ronsha) of '''Fuminashi Shrine''' (ふみなしじんじゃ), which is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}.<ref>[https://shrineheritager.com/mangu-shrine/amp/ Mangū Shrine] - Shrine Heritager</ref>

Based on the enshrined deity, it was originally a {{ill|Hachiman shrine|Q11390939|qid=Q11390939}}, and it is thought that this name later became corrupted into “Mangū.”

=== Enshrined deity ===
* {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|qid=Q317997|lt=Hondawake no Mikoto}}

=== Auxiliary shrines ===
* Moriyama Inari Shrine – located at the summit of Moriyama.<ref name="isan"/>
